note: NECO Chemistry round 7 (R40 top-up): three states of matter; physical change; element, atom, ion and molecule defined; covalent and ionic bonds; valency; acid and base defined; alkali; monobasic; pH as hydrogen-ion measure; saturated solution; molarity; crystallisation; water of crystallisation; efflorescence; chromatography; sublimation; magnetic separation; caustic soda; hydrogen lightest; neon signs; helium balloons; soft water. Scanned against the whole Chemistry pool (WAEC, NECO and JAMB stems).
